title: Prōnōmina Dēmōnstrātīva
subtitle: Οὗτος (hic/iste), ἐκεῖνος (ille), et ὅδε (hic, proximior) — trēs gradūs dēmōnstrātiōnis, cum ūsū attribūtīvō speciālī.
objectives: Dēclīnāre plēnē οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο (hic/iste) per omnēs cāsūs, utrōque numerō
Dēclīnāre ἐκεῖνος, ἐκείνη, ἐκεῖνο (ille), sequēns patrōnum regulārem classis prīmae iam nōtum
Distinguere trēs gradūs dēmōnstrātiōnis: ὅδε (hic, proximus locūtōrī), οὗτος (iste, proximus audītōrī/contextuī), ἐκεῖνος (ille, distāns)
Applicāre rēgulam positiōnis speciālem dēmōnstrātīvōrum: semper EXTRĀ articulum-nōmen, numquam intrā (dīversē ab adiectīvīs normālibus)

content.intro: Ἀγάθων λέγει· οὗτος ὁ ἀνὴρ σοφός ἐστιν. Notāvistī: οὗτος — “hic”. Graecum distinguit TRĒS gradūs dēmōnstrātiōnis, ubi Latīnum classicum habet duo prīncipālia (hic/ille): ὅδε, οὗτος, ἐκεῖνος.
content.explanation:
Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Οὗτος ὁ ἀνὴρ σοφός ἐστιν.” Μελίτη λέγει· “Ταύτην τὴν πόλιν φιλῶ.” Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Τοῦτο τὸ βιβλίον καλόν ἐστιν — ἐκεῖνοι οἱ στρατιῶται, ἐκείνης τῆς ἡμέρας, ἀνδρεῖοι ἦσαν.” “Ταῦτα λέγω,” λέγει Μελίτη. (Agathōn dīcit: “Hic vir sapiēns est.” Melitē dīcit: “Hanc urbem amō.” Agathōn dīcit: “Hic liber pulcher est — illī mīlitēs, illō diē, fortēs erant.” “Haec dīcō,” dīcit Melitē.)

Notāvistīne οὗτος, ταύτην, τοῦτο, ἐκεῖνοι, ἐκείνης, ταῦτα — sex fōrmae dēmōnstrātīvae, cāsūs/genera/numerī dīversī? Οὗτος est constrūctum ex articulō (τ-) plūs elementō dēmōnstrātīvō (-αυτ-/-ουτ-), unde fōrmae videntur combīnāre spīritum asperum initiālem cum τ mediāle — patrōnus proprius memoriae mandandus. Ἐκεῖνος, contrā, dēclīnātur exāctē sīcut adiectīvum classis prīmae regulāre (Gradū II, patrōnus καλός), sine ūllā irregulāritāte.

rules.heading: a) Οὗτος, Αὕτη, Τοῦτο (hic, iste)
rules.body:
CāsusMasc. sg.Fem. sg.Neut. sg.
Nōm.οὗτοςαὕτητοῦτο
Gen.τούτουταύτηςτούτου
Dat.τούτῳταύτῃτούτῳ
Acc.τοῦτονταύτηντοῦτο

Plūrālis: masc. οὗτοι, τούτων, τούτοις, τούτους — fem. αὗται, τούτων, ταύταις, ταύτας — neut. ταῦτα, τούτων, τούτοις, ταῦτα. Mnēmonicum: quandōcumque τ+ vōcālis long apparet, spīritus est semper lēnis (τούτου); quandōcumque nōn est τ initiāle (nōminātīvus tantum), spīritus est asper (οὗτος, αὕτη).

rules.heading: b) Ἐκεῖνος, Ἐκείνη, Ἐκεῖνο (ille) — Regulāre
rules.body: Dēclīnātur exāctē sīcut adiectīvum classis prīmae regulāre (patrōnus καλός/καλή/καλόν, Gradū II): ἐκεῖνος, ἐκείνου, ἐκείνῳ, ἐκεῖνον (masc. sg.); ἐκείνη, ἐκείνης, ἐκείνῃ, ἐκείνην (fem. sg.); ἐκεῖνο, ἐκείνου, ἐκείνῳ, ἐκεῖνο (neut. sg.) — plūrālis sequēns idem patrōnum (ἐκεῖνοι, ἐκεῖναι, ἐκεῖνα, etc.). Nūlla irregulāritās hīc, distīnctē ab οὗτος.

rules.heading: c) Rēgula Positiōnis Speciālis
rules.body: Omnia trīa dēmōnstrātīva (ὅδε, οὗτος, ἐκεῖνος) requīrunt positiōnem praedicātīvam cum articulō — id est, extrā structūram articulum-nōmen, numquam intrā (dīversē ab adiectīvīs normālibus classis prīmae, Gradū II): οὗτος ὁ ἀνήρ vel ὁ ἀνὴρ οὗτος (“hic vir”) — NUMQUAM *ὁ οὗτος ἀνήρ. Comparā cum πᾶς (Gradū III priōre), quod monstrat similem flexibilitātem positiōnis cum nuance semantica propria.

examples: οὗτος ὁ ἀνὴρ σοφός ἐστιν. — Hic vir sapiēns est. (dēmōnstrātīvum extrā articulum-nōmen)
ταύτην τὴν πόλιν φιλῶ. — Hanc urbem amō. (accūsātīvus fēminīnus)
ἐκεῖνοι οἱ στρατιῶται ἀνδρεῖοι ἦσαν. — Illī mīlitēs fortēs erant.
τοῦτο τὸ βιβλίον καλόν ἐστιν. — Hic liber pulcher est. (neutrum)
ταῦτα λέγω. — Haec dīcō. (neutrum plūrāle, referēns ad quae modo dicta sunt)
ἐκείνης τῆς ἡμέρας. — Illīus dieī. (genetīvus temporis, fēminīnum)

commonMistakes.wrong: Collocāre dēmōnstrātīvum intrā articulum-nōmen (ut adiectīvum normāle), scrībendo *ὁ οὗτος ἀνήρ.
commonMistakes.right: Semper collocāre dēmōnstrātīvum EXTRĀ structūram articulum-nōmen: οὗτος ὁ ἀνήρ vel ὁ ἀνὴρ οὗτος.
commonMistakes.why: Rēgula positiōnis speciālis distinguit dēmōnstrātīva ab adiectīvīs normālibus — error hīc est frequēns apud incipientēs quī applicant regulam adiectīvī normālis.

commonMistakes.wrong: Applicāre patrōnum irregulārem οὗτος ad ἐκεῖνος, quaerendō fōrmās speciālēs quae nōn exsistunt.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī ἐκεῖνος est prōrsus regulāre, sequēns exāctē patrōnum καλός classis prīmae adiectīvōrum.
commonMistakes.why: Discipulus, doctus irregulāritātem οὗτος, potest incorrēcte suppōnere omnia dēmōnstrātīva esse irregulāria.

commonMistakes.wrong: Cōnfundere trēs gradūs dēmōnstrātiōnis (ὅδε/οὗτος/ἐκεῖνος), tractandō eōs ut synōnyma perfecta.
commonMistakes.right: Distinguere: ὅδε = proximus locūtōrī, οὗτος = proximus audītōrī/contextuī, ἐκεῖνος = distāns.
commonMistakes.why: Discrīmen trichotomicum reflectit nuance semantica genuīnē absentem in linguīs modernīs bīnāriīs (this/that).

exercises.instructions: Lege, deinde responde secundum sensum, non verbum singulum.

items.prompt: Quālis est hic liber, secundum Agathōnem?

exercises.title: Quid Vērē Dīcitur? (Ex Sēnsū)
exercises.instructions: Relege sententiās suprā. Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit, ex sēnsū, nōn ex nōmine dēmōnstrātīvī.

items.statement: Ἀγάθων dīcit illum virum (nōn hunc) esse sapientem.
items.explanation: Falsum: “οὗτος ὁ ἀνήρ” significat “hic vir”, nōn “ille vir”.

items.statement: Illī mīlitēs, illō diē, fuērunt timidī.
Hic liber, secundum Ἀγάθωνem, est malus.
items.explanation: Falsum: “τοῦτο τὸ βιβλίον καλόν ἐστιν” — bonus/pulcher.

items.prompt: Quae est fōrma nōminātīvī singulāris fēminīnī οὗτος?
items.explanation: Nōminātīvus fēminīnus: αὕτη (spīritus asper, τ absēns).

items.prompt: Ubi collocātur dēmōnstrātīvum relātīvē ad articulum-nōmen?
options: extrā, semper (ante vel post tōtam structūram)
items.explanation: Rēgula speciālis: dēmōnstrātīva semper extrā articulum-nōmen.
Ἐκεῖνος indicat distantiam maximam trium gradūum.

items.prompt: Quae fōrma est genetīvus singulāris masculīnus οὗτος?

items.statement: Graecum distinguit trēs gradūs dēmōnstrātiōnis (ὅδε/οὗτος/ἐκεῖνος), ubi linguae modernae saepe distinguunt sōlum duōs.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: trichotomia Graeca (proximus locūtōrī/audītōrī/distāns) est magis fīna quam “this/that”.

items.statement: Dēmōnstrātīva possunt collocārī intrā structūram articulum-nōmen, sīcut adiectīva normālia.
items.explanation: Falsum: dēmōnstrātīva requīrunt positiōnem extrā, semper.

items.statement: Ἐκεῖνος habet fōrmās irregulārēs sīmilēs illīs οὗτος.
Nōminātīvus plūrālis neutrī οὗτος est ταῦτα.

summary: Οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο (hic/iste): fōrmae combinant spīritum asperum (nōm.) cum τ mediāle (cāsūs obliquī) — patrōnus memoriae mandandus.
Ἐκεῖνος, ἐκείνη, ἐκεῖνο (ille): prōrsus regulāre, sequēns patrōnum καλός classis prīmae.
Trēs gradūs: ὅδε (proximus locūtōrī), οὗτος (proximus audītōrī/contextuī), ἐκεῖνος (distāns).
Dēmōnstrātīva semper collocantur EXTRĀ articulum-nōmen, numquam intrā — rēgula speciālis distīncta ab adiectīvīs normālibus.
